texto: Thirteen questions about food, shopping, city, leisure and travel.
The result guides what should be reviewed; it alone does not certify a full level.

opciones.explicacion: Любить has a direct object in accusative: рыба → рыбу.
Рыба is in nominee; here it is the direct object of люблю.
Рыбой is instrumental; as a direct object of люблю it is used рыбу.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 6. How do you say «coffee with milk»?

opciones.explicacion: «With» of accompaniment: с + instrumental, молоко → молоком.
Беш means «without», not «with».
И significa «y»: «café y leche».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 7. What do you mean, «these shoes»?

opciones.explicacion: Туфли is used in plural; the plural demonstrative is эти.
It is masculine singular and does not match the plural туфли.
It is feminine singular and does not match the plural туфли.
After the comparative больше, чем introduces the second term: «that Madrid».
Что significa «qué/lo que»; no introduce aquí el segundo término de la comparación.
Как means «how / how»; the comparison with больше uses чем.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 8. You're going to work on a bus. What do you say?

opciones.texto: Я еду на работу на автобусе.
opciones.explicacion: Еду express movement in vehicle; на работу marca destinado and на автобусе, the medium.
Иду на работу пешком means «I'm going to work on foot.», not by bus.

opciones.texto: Я еду на работе на автобусе.
opciones.explicacion: To indicate destination is used на работу; на работе means «at work».
Мне надо + infinitive expresses necessity or obligation: «I have to work.».
Могу is the first person form of мочь: «Я могу работать» = «I can work.».
The form of the first person is: «Я умею работать» = «I know how to work».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. What do you mean, «I play guitar.»?

opciones.explicacion: With instruments is used играть на + prepositional case: на гитаре.
Играть на is used with instruments; играть в, with games and sports.
The verb is missing: «I play guitar.» is «Я играю на гитаре».
Буду is the future of быть; with the infinitive form the imperfect future: буду работать.
Был is past masculine of быть; tomorrow requires future.
Будет is a third person's future singular; with я it is used буду.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. How do you say «in summer»?

opciones.explicacion: The stations are usually expressed with instruments without preposition: летом.
Зимой significa «en invierno»; para verano se usa летом.
For «in summer» time, the normal form is летом, without preposition.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 10. A woman says «I was home yesterday.». How do you say that?

opciones.explicacion: In the past, быть agrees with the speaker: a woman says была.
Был is the masculine form; a woman uses была.
That's future.
Голова is the subject of болит: «У меня болит голова» = «My head hurts.».
Болен is the short adjective masculine; it does not match голова, which is feminine.
Мне плохо expresses general discomfort; for the headache it is said to be меня болит голова.

bloques.audio: Вчера мы ходили в кино, а потом ужинали в ресторане.

opciones.texto: We went to the movies yesterday and then we had dinner in a restaurant.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase says that we went to the movies yesterday and we had dinner later.

opciones.texto: Tomorrow we'll go to the movies and then we'll have dinner in a restaurant.
opciones.explicacion: It's past.

opciones.texto: We went to the theater yesterday and then we had dinner at home.
opciones.explicacion: Кино = cinema; в ресторане = in a restaurant.

bloques.frase: Завтра я еду в Москву на поезде.
bloques.traduccion: I'm going to Moscow by train tomorrow
bloques.explicacion: Tomorrow + I + go + to Moscow + on + train.
